AttributeList.Text:
This block is used instead of the hardware clock memory byte. The squarewave signals on the outputs of the block are the same as the clock bits of the clock memory byte.
**Parameters** The block have only the output parameters.

Comment/Function: This function generates the same clocksignals like the clock memorybites.

Comment.MultiLanguageText: The outputs are boolean values witch toggles at the desired frequency. The accuracy of the pulsewidth depends on the cycle time of the PLC, but the absolute Position of the clock signal is fixed. So it's posible to use this signals for time calculation.
